style: Say thoughtfully and warmly, like a design studio mentor
lines: Pick a challenge card and press Start.
Drag each card onto the branch where it belongs, or tap a card and then a branch. Then press Check tree.
Sort each item with Criterion or Constraint. Then use each criterion’s slider to say how much it matters.
Turn the option tiles on and off and watch the hottest day change. Press Save design to keep one.
Pick a Source, then tap up to three Steps in order. Press Save design to keep one.
Type your design names, then give each one a score for every criterion. Press Save design when done.
Save at least two designs in Prototype first. Then come back here to compare them.
Move the weight sliders in the column headers. Watch whether the top design changes.
The top design just changed. That weight is doing a lot of work.
That design breaks a constraint. It cannot win until you change it.
Card placed. Tap another card, or press Check tree.
Tree checked. Read the feedback on each card, then move any card you want to rethink.
Sort checked. Edit a sort or limit, or open Prototype to test your priorities.
Design saved. Change some options to test a different idea, or open Trade-offs.
Three steps is the limit here. Tap a chosen step to remove it.
Name your three branches. Add a card, then tap a branch to place it.
Type a criterion or constraint, choose its direction, and press Add item.
Your challenge has been cleared on this device.
Design saved. Change the design name and values to test another idea, or open Trade-offs.
Open Criteria and press Add item before entering design evidence.
